headline.zh: 民主党横扫国会，选民向数据中心说不
headline.en: Democrats sweep Congress as voters reject the Iran war and data centers

lede.zh: 美国中期选举结果揭晓：民主党同时拿下众议院和参议院，特朗普承认伊朗战争拖累了共和党，副总统万斯更公开与这场战争划清界限。市场应声上涨，油价跌破每桶90美元。几乎所有关于数据中心的地方公投也都遭到否决，给AI基建热潮泼了一盆冷水。
lede.en: America's midterms delivered a clean sweep: Democrats took both the House and the Senate, Trump conceded the Iran war hurt his party, and JD Vance went further and distanced himself from it. Stocks jumped and oil slid below $90 a barrel. Voters also turned down data centers in nearly every ballot measure, a cold shower for the AI building boom.

title.zh: AI流水线揪出948个Linux提权漏洞
title.en: OpenAI's automated pipeline finds and patches 948 Linux root bugs

hook.zh: 能让普通用户一步变成“超级管理员”的漏洞,OpenAI的系统一口气找出948个,还写好了补丁。
hook.en: Nearly a thousand ways to seize full control of a Linux machine, found and fixed with no human in the loop.

story.zh:
OpenAI周三发文,标题叫《少了一千条通往root的路》。它搭了一条全自动流水线,在Linux内核里找出948个“本地提权”漏洞,逐个验证确实存在,再自动生成修补补丁。

本地提权,好比访客已经进了大楼大堂,却发现一扇没锁好的门直通总控室。攻击者先拿到一个普通账户,再借这类漏洞变成root,也就是Linux里权限最高的管理员。内核跑在海量服务器、手机和设备底层,这类漏洞一直让安全团队头疼。

找漏洞、复现、写补丁,传统上是资深工程师一个个手工完成的细活。OpenAI这次把三步串成一条无人值守的流水线,规模接近一千个。同一天,OpenAI还宣布安全产品Daybreak Red已通过Amazon Bedrock登陆AWS GovCloud(美东),向获批客户提供GPT-5.6 Cyber模型,用于经授权的网络安全工作。

接下来的看点是,这些补丁有多少能通过内核维护者的审核。公告摘要没有交代这一点。
story.en:
OpenAI published a post on Wednesday titled "A thousand fewer paths to root." It describes an autonomous pipeline that combed through the Linux kernel, found 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities, confirmed each one was real, and then wrote a patch for it.

A local privilege escalation is like a visitor with a lobby badge discovering an unlocked door straight into the building's control room. An attacker starts with an ordinary account, then uses the flaw to become "root," the all-powerful administrator on a Linux machine. Because the kernel sits underneath huge numbers of servers, phones and devices, these bugs are a perennial headache.

Finding a bug, reproducing it and writing a fix has traditionally been painstaking manual work for experienced engineers. OpenAI says it chained all three steps together without a human steering, at a scale of nearly a thousand. The same day, it announced that Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock, giving approved customers access to GPT-5.6 Cyber for authorized security work.

The open question is how many of these patches kernel maintainers will review and accept. OpenAI's summary doesn't say.

why.zh: 内核漏洞补得越快,黑客入侵后“一步登天”的机会就越少;但同样的能力也意味着,找漏洞的门槛正在被AI大幅拉低。
why.en: Every kernel hole closed is one less way for an intruder to turn a small foothold into total control — but the same capability shows how cheap bug-hunting is becoming for everyone.

pro.zh: 关键在“验证”这一环:自动化漏洞挖掘从不缺误报,真正昂贵的是确认漏洞可被利用,并写出不破坏功能的补丁。如果三步都能交给机器,瓶颈就转移到上游维护者的审阅带宽,近千个补丁对任何开源项目都是不小的负担。GovCloud上线则说明,网络安全专用模型正在进入政府合规环境。
pro.en: The expensive step is validation: automated bug-finding has always produced noise, and the real cost lies in proving exploitability and writing a fix that doesn't break anything. If machines can do all three, the bottleneck shifts to upstream maintainers' review bandwidth — nearly a thousand patches is a heavy load for any open-source project. The GovCloud launch shows security-specialised models moving into government compliance environments.

label.zh: 被找到并生成补丁的内核提权漏洞

explain.zh: 已经拿到普通账户的人,借漏洞把自己升级成管理员,像访客溜进了总控室。
explain.en: Someone with an ordinary account exploits a flaw to become administrator — a visitor slipping into the control room.

explain.zh: Linux系统里权限最高的账户,相当于手握大楼所有房间的万能钥匙。
explain.en: The top account on a Linux system, like holding the master key to every room in the building.

explain.zh: 操作系统最底层的核心程序,负责调度硬件,好比大楼的地基和电路。
explain.en: The core of an operating system that manages the hardware — the building's foundation and wiring.

title.zh: Kimi、腾讯、Ripple同日放出模型权重
title.en: Kimi, Tencent and Ripple release open-weight models on the same day

hook.zh: 一天之内三款开放权重模型扎堆登场,可它们答的根本不是同一张考卷。
hook.en: Three open-weight models landed in one day — and none of them sat the same exam.

story.zh:
周三,Kimi K3.1 Pro的模型权重登上Hugging Face,在Hacker News拿到471分。同一天,腾讯发布混元Hy4,Ricursive推出Ripple-65B预览版,三款开放权重模型撞在一起。

Kimi K3.1 Pro号称自家最强的3T级模型,能看图、能当智能体,上下文长达100万token。技术上,它把全注意力层换成“门控DeepSeek稀疏注意力”:好比读长书时不再每写一个字就回翻全书,只翻相关章节。权重用MXFP4格式存储,训练时就让模型适应这种“四舍五入”。OrcaRouter测算权重共1.56TB,许可证还设有一条2000万美元的门槛。

腾讯Hy4能看图,还能在App里替人点来点去,有报道称规模是Hy3的2.6倍、成本极低。Ripple-65B则自称美国开放权重模型中智能体编程第一。

麻烦在于考卷不统一:Kimi不少成绩是用Claude Code框架自测,或摘自别家博客。OrcaRouter直言Ripple和Kimi“没有共同考试”。谁更强,还得等独立评测。
story.en:
On Wednesday the weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro went up on Hugging Face, drawing 471 points on Hacker News. The same day Tencent released Hunyuan Hy4 and Ricursive put out a preview of Ripple-65B — three open-weight models in one news cycle.

Kimi K3.1 Pro is billed as its makers' most capable 3T-class model: natively multimodal, built for agent work, with a 1-million-token context window. The key change is swapping full attention for Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention — instead of rereading the whole book for every new word, the model flips only to the relevant chapters. Weights are stored in the compact MXFP4 format, with the model trained to tolerate that rounding. OrcaRouter puts the weights at 1.56 TB and flags a licensing threshold of $20 million.

Tencent's Hy4 can see images and click through apps; one report says it is 2.6 times bigger than Hy3, and another calls it extremely low-cost. Ripple-65B claims to be the best US open-weight model for agentic coding.

The catch: no common yardstick. Many Kimi scores come from its own runs in the Claude Code harness or are lifted from rivals' blogs, and OrcaRouter notes Ripple and Kimi share no benchmark. Independent tests are still missing.

why.zh: 开放权重让企业可以自己下载、部署这些模型,不必只依赖闭源API;但在独立评测出来前,宣传成绩只能打个问号。
why.en: Open weights let companies run capable models on their own hardware instead of renting closed APIs — but until independent tests arrive, the headline scores deserve a question mark.

pro.zh: Kimi的评测脚注值得细读:部分成绩为内部基准,PostTrainBench用H20而非H100跑,ProgramBench按95%阈值折算成0/1,对手分数来源不一。从门控MLA换成门控DSA,是用稀疏选择换掉全量注意力,以降低长上下文计算成本;MXFP4配合量化感知训练则压缩显存占用。即便如此,1.56TB的权重仍远非个人电脑能跑。
pro.en: Kimi's benchmark footnotes repay reading: some scores are internal, PostTrainBench ran on H20s rather than H100s, ProgramBench was collapsed to pass/fail at a 95% threshold, and rival numbers come from mixed sources. Replacing Gated MLA with Gated DSA trades full attention for sparse selection to cut long-context compute, while MXFP4 with quantization-aware training shrinks memory. Even so, 1.56 TB of weights is far beyond a personal machine.

label.en: size of Kimi K3.1 Pro's weights

explain.zh: 公开训练好的模型参数供人下载运行,像把做好的菜连同配方交出,但不一定公开整个厨房。
explain.en: Publishing a trained model's parameters for anyone to download and run — handing over the finished recipe, not necessarily the whole kitchen.

explain.zh: 模型只挑相关的内容重点看,而不是每次都通读全文,长文本处理因此更省算力。
explain.en: The model focuses only on relevant parts rather than rereading everything, saving compute on long inputs.

explain.zh: 用更少的位数存数字,好比把价格四舍五入到角,省空间但略损精度。
explain.en: Storing numbers with fewer digits, like rounding prices to the nearest dime — smaller, slightly less precise.

title.zh: 新图像模型让ChatGPT会做动图
title.en: OpenAI's Images 2.6 lets ChatGPT make GIFs and edit more precisely

hook.zh: 对ChatGPT说一句“做个跳舞的猫”,现在得到的是一张会动的GIF。
hook.en: Ask ChatGPT for "a gif of a cat dancing" and you now get one that actually moves.

story.zh:
OpenAI周三推出Images 2.6。在官方演示里,用户输入“能做一个跳舞的猫的GIF吗”,ChatGPT直接生成动图,还能调节播放速度、逐帧查看和修改,做好后可以分享。上传一张照片,也能让它动起来。

此前ChatGPT没法一步生成GIF。GIF本质上是一本翻页小人书,一连串静态画面快速切换;难点在于每一帧里的猫都得是同一只猫。这次更新还带来更快的出图速度、更精确的局部编辑,并支持参考图片。

新模型正向所有ChatGPT和Codex用户推送,覆盖网页、桌面和手机端。开发者那边,API新增GPT-Image-2.6 Flare和Sunburst两个版本,分别主打更快和更高质量,另有新的控制选项。OpenAI称,ChatGPT和API每周生成的图片已超过40亿张,9月时还是30亿张。
story.en:
OpenAI launched Images 2.6 on Wednesday. In the company's demo, a user types "can you make a gif of a cat dancing?" and ChatGPT returns an animated GIF, with controls to change playback speed, step through it frame by frame, edit individual frames and share the result. Upload a photo and it can animate that too.

Until now ChatGPT couldn't natively make a GIF in a single step. A GIF is essentially a flipbook — a string of still images shown in quick succession — and the hard part is keeping the cat the same cat in every frame. The update also brings faster image generation, more precise editing and support for image references.

Images 2.6 is rolling out to all ChatGPT and Codex users on web, desktop and mobile. For developers, the API gains GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst, aimed at faster and higher-quality generation respectively, plus new controls. OpenAI says people now generate more than 4 billion images a week across ChatGPT and the API, up from 3 billion in September.

why.zh: 表情包、产品演示这类小动画以后一句话就能出,做内容的门槛又低了一截;每周40亿张的用量也说明图像已是ChatGPT的主力功能之一。
why.en: Reaction GIFs and quick product animations now take one sentence, lowering the bar for anyone making content — and 4 billion images a week shows imagery is now a core ChatGPT use.

pro.zh: 从单张图到多帧动画,核心挑战是帧间一致性:角色外观、光照和背景需要在时间轴上保持稳定,否则会闪烁变形。逐帧编辑功能意味着用户可以手动修补个别跑偏的帧。API拆出快速版和高质量版,则是让开发者在延迟、成本与画质之间自行取舍。
pro.en: Moving from single images to multi-frame animation hinges on temporal consistency: a character's look, lighting and background must hold steady across frames or the result flickers. Frame-level editing gives users a way to repair individual frames that drift. Splitting the API into a faster and a higher-quality tier lets developers choose their own trade-off between latency, cost and fidelity.

label.en: images generated weekly across ChatGPT and API

explain.zh: 让其他软件调用OpenAI模型的接口,像餐厅给外卖平台开的接单窗口。
explain.en: The interface other software uses to call OpenAI's models — like a restaurant's order window for delivery apps.

title.zh: 美国中期选举:数据中心几乎全线落败
title.en: Data centers lost the US midterms almost everywhere they appeared

hook.zh: 从小镇公投到州长选举,美国选民用选票对AI数据中心说了“不”。
hook.en: From town referendums to governors' races, American voters said no to AI data centers.

story.zh:
周二美国中期选举,数据中心成了大输家。佛州埃奇沃特把禁令写进市宪章;堪萨斯州埃尔多拉多十年内禁建峰值用电超10兆瓦的数据中心。CNBC和彭博称,几十项相关投票里只有一个地方投了赞成;Redbud Consulting口径不同,称45项地方公投中有33项结果将限制建设。

NBC出口民调显示,76%的选民反对在自家社区建数据中心。两党候选人都拿“数据中心”给对手贴标签。

最大震动在得州。民主党人吉娜·伊诺霍萨击败现任州长阿博特,她主张全州暂停建设;塔拉里科也拿下参议院席位。得州是全美增长最快的数据中心市场。周三盘前,AI数据中心股和SpaceX应声下跌。

行业的钱也没买到结果:握有1亿美元的亲AI超级政治行动委员会“引领未来”几乎没起作用。科技公司则辩称选民是“反特朗普”而非“反科技”,有人开始畅想把数据中心搬上太空。
story.en:
Tuesday's midterms were a rout for data centers. Edgewater, Florida, wrote a ban into its city charter; El Dorado, Kansas, barred facilities with peak loads over 10MW for a decade. CNBC and Bloomberg report that only one community out of dozens voted in favor. Redbud Consulting counts differently: 33 of 45 local measures will restrict development.

In NBC's exit poll, 76% of voters said they opposed data centers in their communities. Candidates in both parties branded opponents with the issue.

The biggest shock came in Texas, the fastest-growing data center market in the US. Democrat Gina Hinojosa, who backs a statewide moratorium, unseated Governor Greg Abbott, and Democrat James Talarico won a Senate seat over Ken Paxton. AI data center stocks and SpaceX slipped in Wednesday premarket trading.

Industry money bought little. Leading the Future, a pro-AI super PAC network with a $100 million war chest, barely moved the needle. Tech firms are arguing the backlash was "anti-Trump," not "anti-tech," rebranding facilities as "compute campuses," and some are daydreaming about data centers in orbit.

why.zh: 如果得州、佐治亚等建设重镇真的暂停审批,数百个规划中的项目可能延期,AI算力扩张和相关股票都会受影响。
why.en: If hubs like Texas and Georgia pause approvals, hundreds of planned projects could stall — a direct hit to the AI compute buildout and the stocks riding on it.

pro.zh: 银行和资管机构已把地方反对视为信贷风险,这会抬高项目融资成本。值得注意的是,得州参议院选战中两党候选人都主张取消部分税收减免、让数据中心自担能源设施成本,说明“让开发商自己买单”正在成为跨党共识。阿博特今夏启动的电网接入审计,本身也可能拖慢新项目并网。
pro.en: Banks and asset managers already treat local opposition as a credit risk, which raises financing costs. Notably, both Texas Senate candidates wanted to strip some tax exemptions and make data centers pay their own energy-infrastructure costs — "developers pay" is becoming a bipartisan position. Abbott's own summer audit of grid connections could also slow new hookups.

label.zh: 反对在本社区建数据中心的选民
label.en: of voters oppose data centers in their community

explain.zh: 在一段时间内冻结新项目审批,好比给施工按下暂停键。
explain.en: A temporary freeze on approving new projects — a pause button on construction.

explain.zh: 可以无限额募款、花钱影响选举的组织,但不能直接给候选人捐钱。
explain.en: A group that can raise and spend unlimited money on elections, but can't donate directly to candidates.

explain.zh: 建造巨型数据中心的科技巨头,用电量堪比一座小城。
explain.en: Tech giants that build enormous data centers, some drawing as much power as a small city.

title.zh: OpenAI收购代码工具公司并挖角对手
title.en: OpenAI buys Pierre Computer and hires Claude Code's former product head

hook.zh: 一天之内,OpenAI买下一家代码存储公司,又从Anthropic挖来了Claude Code的产品负责人。
hook.en: In one day, OpenAI bought a code-storage startup and hired the woman who ran product for its rival's coding hit.

story.zh:
OpenAI周三宣布收购Pierre Computer Company,把这家初创公司构建、理解和审查代码的工具并入Codex,也就是OpenAI自己的AI编程助手。《华尔街日报》报道,交易的重点是把Pierre的代码存储能力带进Codex。

代码存储听上去平淡,却是程序员的“仓库”:代码放在哪、怎么协作、怎么审查,都在这里发生。如今这个位置的老大是微软旗下的GitHub。Axios在独家报道中直言,OpenAI这笔交易瞄准的正是GitHub。

同一天晚些时候,Cat Wu在X上宣布加入OpenAI,负责核心产品的产品管理。她此前是Anthropic旗下Claude Code的产品负责人,而Claude Code正是Codex最直接的竞争对手。《商业内幕》用的词是“挖角”。

公开信息没有提到收购金额。接下来要看,Codex会不会从写代码的助手,变成程序员存放和管理代码的地方。
story.en:
OpenAI said on Wednesday it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, folding the startup's tools for building, understanding and reviewing code into Codex, OpenAI's AI coding agent. The Wall Street Journal reports the point is to bring Pierre's code storage into Codex.

Code storage sounds dull, but it is a programmer's warehouse: where code lives, how teams collaborate on it, how changes get reviewed. The dominant player there is Microsoft's GitHub, and Axios, in an exclusive, framed the deal as OpenAI taking aim at it.

Later the same day, Cat Wu announced on X that she is joining OpenAI to lead product management for its core products. She was previously head of product for Claude Code at Anthropic — the most direct rival to Codex. Business Insider called it a poaching.

The sources don't mention a price. The thing to watch is whether Codex grows from an assistant that writes code into the place where developers keep and manage it.

why.zh: AI编程助手的竞争正从“谁写代码更好”扩展到“谁掌握程序员的工作台”,开发者可能面临更多平台选择,也可能被锁进某一家。
why.en: The coding-AI race is widening from who writes better code to who owns the developer's workbench — more choice for programmers, but also more risk of lock-in.

pro.zh: 代码仓库是AI编程工具的护城河:谁托管代码,谁就离审查、测试、部署整条流程最近,也最容易让智能体直接在上面动手。OpenAI此举是从生成层向基础设施层下探,与GitHub正面相遇。挖来Claude Code的产品负责人,则把对手打磨产品的经验直接带进了自家团队。
pro.en: The code repository is the moat for AI coding tools: whoever hosts the code sits closest to review, testing and deployment, and can let agents act directly on it. OpenAI is moving down from the generation layer into infrastructure, where it meets GitHub head-on. Hiring Claude Code's product lead brings a rival's product playbook straight into the building.

explain.zh: OpenAI的AI编程助手,能根据指令写代码、改代码,像一个随叫随到的程序员同事。
explain.en: OpenAI's AI coding agent that writes and edits code on request — an on-call programmer colleague.

explain.zh: 把代码存在云端供团队协作和审查的服务,相当于程序员的共享仓库。
explain.en: A cloud service where teams store, share and review code — a programmer's shared warehouse.

title.zh: 民主党横扫国会两院，共和党一席未翻
title.en: Democrats sweep Congress as Republicans fail to flip a single seat

hook.zh: 民主党只需在众议院多拿三席，结果拿下近30席，外加参议院，连得州都变了色。
hook.en: Democrats needed three more House seats. They took nearly 30, plus the Senate, and even made gains in Texas.

story.zh:
选前，民主党只需在众议院净增三席就能夺回多数。据CNBC统计，到周三他们已翻转近30个众议院选区、7个参议院席位、5个州长职位和多达12个州议会议院，共和党则一席未翻。NBC预计民主党将拿下约255个众议院席位，可能是近二十年来最大的多数。

这股浪潮一路冲进特朗普的大本营。民主党人塔拉里科在得州赢下联邦参议院席位，民主党还拿下了得州众议院。负责替共和党守住众议院的竞选委员会主席哈德森，连自己的席位也丢了。密歇根的赛义德将成为首位穆斯林参议员。杰弗里斯预计1月3日宣誓，成为首位黑人众议院议长。现任议长约翰逊表示，不再竞选少数党领袖。

舆论普遍把这次投票看作对特朗普的一次公投，焦点是移民打击、打了八个月的伊朗战争，以及推高油价和菜价的关税。多个州的公投还支持堕胎权，并否决了特朗普推动的选区重划。

明年1月起，民主党可以通过法案、召开听证、启动调查，但特朗普手里仍握着否决权。
story.en:
Democrats needed a net gain of just three House seats on Tuesday. By Wednesday, CNBC counted nearly 30 flipped House districts, along with seven Senate seats, five governorships and up to 12 state legislative chambers. Republicans had not flipped a single seat. NBC projects Democrats will hold about 255 House seats, possibly their largest majority in nearly two decades.

The wave reached deep into Trump country. James Talarico won a US Senate seat in Texas, and Democrats took the Texas House. Richard Hudson, the North Carolina congressman who ran the House GOP's campaign arm, lost his own race. Michigan's Abdul El-Sayed will become the first Muslim US senator. Hakeem Jeffries is expected to be sworn in on Jan. 3 as the first Black speaker. Speaker Johnson says he won't run to lead House Republicans in the minority.

The vote was widely read as a verdict on Trump's immigration crackdown, the eight-month Iran war, and tariffs that pushed up the price of gas and groceries. In state ballot measures, voters also backed abortion rights and rejected Trump-backed redistricting.

From January, Democrats can pass bills, hold hearings and open investigations. They still can't make Trump sign anything, because he keeps his veto.

why.zh: 这是特朗普第二任期内国会第一次能对他说“不”。接下来更可能出现的是传票、调查，以及围绕战争拨款和关税的拉锯，而不是一大批新法律。
why.en: For the first time in Trump's second term, Congress can say no. Expect subpoenas, investigations and fights over war funding and tariffs rather than a flood of new laws.

pro.zh: 掌控两院意味着民主党握有议程设置权和传票权，但法律仍需总统签字。推翻否决需要两院各三分之二票数，255席的众议院也远远不够。真正的杠杆在钱袋子上：拨款法案由国会来写，伊朗战争经费和各部门预算会成为主战场。此外，共和党中期重划选区的尝试宣告失败，也会影响2028年的选区版图。
pro.en: Unified control gives Democrats the agenda and subpoena power, but laws still need Trump's signature. Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of both chambers, far beyond even a 255-seat House. The real lever is money: Congress writes spending bills, so funding for the Iran war and federal agencies becomes the battleground. The failure of the GOP's mid-decade redistricting push also shapes the maps heading into 2028.

label.zh: 民主党预计众议院席位（过半需218席）

explain.zh: 总统可以拒签国会通过的法案，好比家长对孩子的申请说“不行”，国会要两院各三分之二同意才能推翻。
explain.en: The president's power to reject a bill Congress passed, like a parent saying no. Congress needs two-thirds of both chambers to overrule it.

explain.zh: 原本由一党占据的席位，这次被另一党赢走。
explain.en: A seat that changes hands from one party to the other.

explain.zh: 重新画选区边界，就像重新切蛋糕，切法不同，哪个党吃到更多就不同。
explain.en: Redrawing electoral district lines. Like re-cutting a cake, how you slice it decides which party gets more.

title.zh: 特朗普承认伊朗战争拖累选情，万斯公开切割
title.en: Trump admits the Iran war hurt Republicans; Vance goes further

hook.zh: 惨败次日，总统说他“还会再干一次”，副总统却说输就输在这场战争。
hook.en: The day after the rout, the president said he'd do it again, and his vice-president said the war is why they lost.

story.zh:
中期选举惨败后第二天，特朗普承认伊朗战争很可能拖累了共和党，但坚称自己“还会再干一次”。他还抱怨党内候选人没法把选民对他的“爱转移过去”。副总统万斯说得更直白：“我们输的原因就是这场战争，总统自己昨晚也这么说了。”

这场打了八个月的战争推高了全球油价。CNN认为，万斯此举是在为2028年铺路。其他共和党人也呼吁特朗普调整方向。连欧洲极右翼都把失败归咎于这场战争，开始与他保持距离。

德黑兰则把结果当成自己的胜利。伊朗议长、首席谈判代表卡利巴夫写道：“不管是出于良知还是生活成本，美国人对战争说了不，我们赞同。”德黑兰集会上，一幅印有特朗普、万斯和内塔尼亚胡的巨型横幅被焚烧。革命广场上的广告牌则写着“我们要杀死特朗普”。

海湾国家正忙着斡旋，担心战火一旦重燃会比上次更糟。特朗普对《金融时报》说，暂无立即打击伊朗的计划。《卫报》则指出，他可能面临“把事情做完”的压力。
story.en:
A day after the midterm rout, President Trump acknowledged the Iran war had likely hurt Republicans, while insisting he would 'do it again.' He also complained that candidates couldn't 'transfer the love' voters have for him. His vice-president went further. 'The reason we lost is the war,' JD Vance posted. 'The president himself said so last night.'

The eight-month war has pushed up fuel prices worldwide. CNN read Vance's break as a bid to keep his 2028 hopes alive, and other Republicans urged Trump to change course. Even Europe's far right blamed the war for the defeat and distanced itself from him.

Tehran claimed the result as its own. Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf, Iran's parliament speaker and chief negotiator, wrote: 'Conscience or the cost of living, Americans said NO TO WAR, and we endorse this message.' Crowds in Tehran burned a giant banner of Trump, Vance and Netanyahu, and a billboard over Enqelab Square read 'We will kill Trump.'

Gulf states are scrambling to mediate, fearing that renewed fighting would be worse than before. Trump told the Financial Times he has no immediate plans to strike Iran. The Guardian notes he may still feel pressure to 'finish the job.'

why.zh: 连总统身边的人都说这场战争输掉了选举，和谈的可能性随之上升，这也是油价下跌的原因。但特朗普一句“还会再干”，意味着升级的选项并没有消失。
why.en: When the president's own team calls the war a political loser, the odds of a deal rise, which is why oil fell. But Trump's 'do it again' keeps escalation on the table.

pro.zh: 在任副总统公开把总统的标志性政策定为败选原因，相当罕见，说明共和党的接班之争已经开打。筹码也在移动：民主党可以卡战争拨款，德黑兰则把美国内斗视为硬撑下去的理由。能源顾问麦克纳利认为，特朗普已为阻止伊朗拥核付出巨大政治代价，不太可能就此罢手。
pro.en: A sitting vice-president publicly blaming his boss's signature policy is rare, and it signals the GOP succession fight has begun. Leverage is shifting: Democrats can squeeze war funding, while Tehran reads American division as a reason to hold firm. Rapidan's Bob McNally argues that Trump, having paid a huge political price to stop an Iranian bomb, is unlikely to walk away from that goal.

title.zh: 道指大涨1500点，油价跌破90美元
title.en: Dow jumps 1,500 points as oil sinks below $90

hook.zh: 华尔街把选举结果读成一个信号：特朗普可能更愿意和伊朗谈了。
hook.en: Wall Street read the election as a signal that Trump may now be readier to make a deal with Iran.

story.zh:
华尔街用一场大涨回应民主党的胜利。周三道指飙升约1500点。油价则大跌：美国原油（WTI）跌8.3%，收于每桶88.12美元，布伦特原油跌8.7%，至94.62美元。

逻辑很简单：选后的特朗普，可能更愿意和伊朗达成协议。10月里，交易员押注选后局势升级，油价涨了超过10%。本周已回吐逾14%，原因包括万斯把败选归咎于战争，以及特朗普表示暂无立即打击伊朗的计划。

其他资产也在动。美元指数跌约0.3%，黄金涨3.4%至每盎司4061美元，白银涨5.1%。苹果、亚马逊、谷歌、Meta和微软上涨，与马斯克相关的股票和数据中心概念股则下跌。美债收益率走低，不过各方报道的幅度不一。

并非人人买账。加拿大帝国商业银行的芭宾认为，油价抛售“可能有点过头了”。Rapidan能源的麦克纳利则仍认为，局势升级的可能性大于达成协议。
story.en:
Wall Street greeted the Democratic sweep with a rally. The Dow soared about 1,500 points on Wednesday, while oil slumped: US crude (WTI) fell 8.3% to $88.12 a barrel and Brent dropped 8.7% to $94.62.

The logic is simple: a chastened Trump may be readier to strike a deal with Iran. Oil climbed more than 10% in October as traders bet on escalation after the vote. It has now given back more than 14% this week, helped by Vance blaming the war for the defeat and Trump saying he had no immediate plans to strike.

Other assets moved too. The dollar index slipped about 0.3%, gold rose 3.4% to $4,061 an ounce and silver jumped 5.1%. Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft gained, but stocks tied to Elon Musk and to data centres fell. Treasury yields moved lower, though reports differed on how far.

Not everyone buys it. CIBC's Rebecca Babin said the oil sell-off 'could be getting a bit overdone,' and Rapidan Energy's Bob McNally still thinks escalation is more likely than a deal.

why.zh: 原油便宜下来，是降低汽油和柴油价格最快的途径。前提是这波跌势能撑得住。
why.en: Cheaper crude is the fastest route to lower petrol and diesel bills, if the drop holds.

pro.zh: 市场往往偏爱分权政府，因为它限制了大手笔的财政动作。StoneX的奥康奈尔预计会出现“财政边缘政策”，刺激减少，长端利率和美元偏弱，对黄金有利。但今年以来黄金仍跌逾6%，通胀和鹰派央行压着它。油价这次下跌靠的是政治判断，实际供应并没有变化。
pro.en: Markets often like divided government because it limits big fiscal moves. StoneX's Rhona O'Connell expects 'fiscal brinkmanship' and less stimulus, which argues for lower long-term yields and a softer dollar, both good for gold. Yet gold is still down more than 6% this year as inflation and hawkish central banks bite. And oil's drop rests on a political read, not a change in physical supply.

label.zh: 美国原油收盘价（单日跌8.3%）

explain.zh: 国际油价的主要标尺，就像菜市场里大家默认参考的那个摊位价格。

explain.en: A measure of the dollar's strength against a basket of major currencies.

title.zh: 欧元区通胀达4%，英央行或三年来首次加息
title.en: Euro-zone inflation hits 4%; Bank of England set to hike

hook.zh: 伊朗战争的账单正寄到欧洲家庭的房贷和电费单上。
hook.en: The bill for the Iran war is landing on European mortgages and energy bills.

story.zh:
周三公布的初步数据显示，欧元区10月通胀升至4%，是2023年9月以来首次触及这一水平。罪魁祸首是能源，能源通胀跳到20.8%。21个欧元区国家全部高于欧洲央行2%的目标，从马耳他的2.3%到立陶宛的6.1%不等。

英吉利海峡对岸，英国央行预计周四把基准利率从3.75%上调到4%。这将是三年多来首次加息，此前已连续六次按兵不动。英国9月通胀升至3.5%，主要被汽油和柴油推高。

事情本不该这样发展。年初，市场还预计英国央行今年降息两次。然后美以在2月空袭伊朗，此后燃料价格一直居高不下。

英国约51万户跟踪型房贷家庭会最先感受到冲击：加息0.25个百分点，一笔典型贷款每月多还约31英镑。市场目前押注欧洲央行12月加息的概率超过72%。
story.en:
Prices in the euro zone rose 4% in the year to October, a flash estimate showed Wednesday. It is the first time inflation has hit that mark since September 2023. The culprit is energy, with energy inflation jumping to 20.8%. All 21 euro countries are above the ECB's 2% target, from Malta at 2.3% to Lithuania at 6.1%.

Across the Channel, the Bank of England is expected on Thursday to lift its key rate from 3.75% to 4%. It would be the first increase in more than three years, after six meetings on hold. UK inflation reached 3.5% in September, driven by petrol and diesel.

It wasn't supposed to go this way. At the start of 2026, the Bank was expected to cut rates twice. Then the US and Israel struck Iran in February, and fuel costs have stayed high ever since.

The roughly 510,000 UK households on tracker mortgages will feel it first. A quarter-point rise adds about £31 a month to a typical loan. Markets now put the odds of an ECB hike in December above 72%.

why.zh: 借钱更贵、存钱稍划算。英国即将续签房贷的人可能每年多付数千英镑，年初还有一轮能源涨价在等着。
why.en: Borrowing gets dearer and saving slightly better. UK homeowners coming off cheap fixed deals face bills thousands of pounds higher a year, with another energy price jump due in January.

pro.zh: 能源推动的通胀属于供给冲击，加息没法直接压低油价。央行真正要防的是涨价蔓延到工资。欧洲央行称核心通胀和工资大体稳定，所以英国央行的问题与其说是到不到4%，不如说是之后怎么走，毕竟增长前景已明显转弱。欧洲央行还受制于法国债市动荡，加息过猛可能加剧压力。
pro.en: Energy-driven inflation is a supply shock that rate hikes can't fix directly. Central banks are hiking to stop it spreading into wages. ECB officials say underlying inflation and wages are broadly stable, so for the BoE the real question is what follows 4%, with growth weakening sharply. The ECB is also boxed in by turmoil in the French bond market, which limits how hard it can tighten.

label.zh: 欧元区10月通胀，三年来最高
label.en: Euro-zone October inflation, a three-year high

explain.zh: 央行借钱给商业银行的价格，就像批发价，决定了你的房贷和存款利率这些零售价。
explain.en: What the central bank charges banks to borrow. Think of it as the wholesale price that sets the retail rates on your mortgage and savings.

explain.zh: 利率紧跟央行基准利率浮动的房贷，央行一动，月供马上跟着变。
explain.en: A mortgage whose rate moves in lockstep with the central bank rate, so payments change straight away.

title.zh: 俄军炸弹两度袭击乌村庄，至少40人死亡
title.en: Russian double-tap bombing kills at least 40 in Ukrainian village

hook.zh: 一段遇难警察的执法记录仪画面，记下了两轮轰炸之间那几分钟。
hook.en: A dead police officer's bodycam captured the minutes between the two strikes.

story.zh:
周一，乌克兰扎波罗热州小村卡梅舒瓦哈（亦拼作Komyshuvakha）的居民聚在一所学校附近领取人道援助，炸弹随即落下。乌克兰警方公布了一名遇难警察的执法记录仪画面：第一轮爆炸后，村民呆望废墟；对讲机里传来还有滑翔炸弹来袭的警告；警察催促众人躲进至少两层深的地下掩体。片刻之后，掩体被击中。

乌方称，共有9枚滑翔炸弹落在村里，部分重达3000公斤。先炸领救济的人，再炸赶来的救援人员和警察。目前已确认至少40人死亡，泽连斯基说可能还有30多人埋在废墟下，搜救已进入第三天。BBC核实了视频拍摄地点。

泽连斯基抱怨“世界几乎没有反应”。自2月和谈中断以来，俄罗斯加紧进攻，而乌克兰几乎耗尽了西方提供的拦截弹。

乌俄美三方会谈将于11月10日至11日在阿布扎比恢复，但分析人士不看好突破。泽连斯基希望美国新国会带来更多援助，克里姆林宫则希望选举结果不影响特朗普的“和平努力”。
story.en:
On Monday, residents of Kamyshuvakha (also spelled Komyshuvakha), a village in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, gathered near a school to collect humanitarian aid. Then the bombs fell. Police footage from the bodycam of an officer killed in the attack shows stunned locals after the first strike, a radio warning that more glide bombs were inbound, and an officer urging people into a shelter at least two floors underground. Moments later, the shelter is hit.

Ukraine says nine glide bombs, some weighing 3,000kg, struck the village, first hitting aid recipients, then the rescuers and police who arrived. At least 40 are confirmed dead. Zelensky says more than 30 may still be under the rubble as the search entered its third day. BBC Verify confirmed where the footage was filmed.

Zelensky lamented 'very little reaction from the world.' Since peace talks were suspended in February, Russia has stepped up attacks while Kyiv has virtually run out of Western-supplied interceptors.

Three-way talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US resume in Abu Dhabi on 10-11 November, though analysts expect no breakthrough. Zelensky hopes the US election brings more help. The Kremlin hopes it won't derail Trump's 'peacemaking efforts.'

why.zh: 拦截弹几乎用光，意味着这类袭击可能越来越多。美国国会易主能否带来新援助，是乌克兰接下来最大的变数。
why.en: With interceptors nearly gone, attacks like this may become more common. Whether a new US Congress sends fresh aid is Ukraine's biggest open question.

pro.zh: “双击”战术专门打击前来救援的人，既推高伤亡，也让救援人员不敢靠近，因此常被视为可能的战争罪。在缺乏防空拦截时，预警加掩体几乎是唯一防线，而这次袭击表明，3000公斤级炸弹连深层掩体也能击穿。三方会谈前夕的高烈度打击，也可视为谈判桌外的施压。
pro.en: Double-tap strikes deliberately target those who rush to help, raising death tolls and deterring rescuers, which is why they are often treated as potential war crimes. Without interceptors, warning plus shelter is nearly the only defence, and this attack shows a 3,000kg bomb can defeat even a deep shelter. Heavy strikes on the eve of talks also work as pressure applied away from the negotiating table.

label.zh: 确认死亡人数，另有30多人或仍被埋
label.en: Confirmed dead, with 30+ possibly still buried

explain.zh: 先炸一次，等救援人员赶到再炸第二次，像是专门冲着救人的人去的。
explain.en: Hitting a target, then striking again once rescuers arrive, so the second blast hits those trying to help.

explain.zh: 给重型炸弹装上翅膀，让它从远处投下后自己滑翔到目标。
explain.en: A heavy bomb fitted with wings so it can be released from a distance and glide to its target.

title.zh: 以色列认证选举结果，赫尔佐格启动组阁磋商
title.en: Israel certifies vote, rejecting Netanyahu's fraud claims

hook.zh: 内塔尼亚胡指称阿拉伯政党“偷走”选举，选举委员会说：没有证据。
hook.en: Netanyahu's camp said Arab-led parties stole the election. The election committee found no evidence.

story.zh:
周三上午在耶路撒冷，中央选举委员会主席索尔伯格把10月27日大选的正式结果交给总统赫尔佐格，并驳回了内塔尼亚胡阵营关于阿拉伯政党“偷走”选举的说法。委员会称，审查“未发现影响选举完整性的违规证据”。几小时前，总检察长巴哈拉夫-米亚拉以缺乏证据为由，拦下了辛贝特要求审讯阿拉伯政党四名政治人物的请求。

数字说明了这场争斗的来由。在120席的议会中，内塔尼亚胡阵营拿下53席，对手艾森科特阵营拿下48席。两个阿拉伯政党联盟借投票率激增，史无前例地拿下19席，成了关键少数。但几乎所有犹太政党都在选前承诺不与他们合作。

赫尔佐格开启为期两天的磋商，决定谁先获得组阁机会。他警告，想避免重新大选，“并非所有承诺都能兑现”，并谴责针对阿拉伯公民的种族主义言论。阿拉伯政党拉姆已推荐艾森科特。据《卫报》报道，赫尔佐格预计会选他，最快周四晚宣布。

获任者有28天组阁，可延长14天，谈判可能持续数周。
story.en:
On Wednesday morning in Jerusalem, election committee chair Justice Noam Sohlberg handed President Isaac Herzog the official results of the 27 October vote. The committee rejected claims from Benjamin Netanyahu's camp that Arab-led parties had 'stolen' the election, saying its review 'found no evidence of irregularities.' Hours earlier, Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara had blocked a Shin Bet request to interrogate four politicians from those parties, citing a lack of evidence.

The numbers explain the fight. Netanyahu's bloc won 53 of the Knesset's 120 seats, and challenger Gadi Eisenkot's bloc won 48. Two Arab-led alliances took an unprecedented 19 on a surge in Arab turnout. That makes them kingmakers, but all but one Jewish party pledged not to govern with them.

Herzog opened two days of consultations to decide who gets the first shot at a coalition. He warned that 'not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled' if Israel wants to avoid another election, and condemned racist attacks on Arab citizens. Ra'am has recommended Eisenkot, and the Guardian reports Herzog is expected to pick him, possibly as soon as Thursday evening.

Whoever is chosen gets 28 days, extendable by 14. Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of a 'pogrom against democracy.'

why.zh: 内塔尼亚胡可能失去组阁主导权，这将牵动以色列的加沙政策、对伊朗战争立场，以及与美国的关系。
why.en: Netanyahu may lose the first shot at governing, which would ripple through Israel's Gaza policy, its stance on the Iran war and its ties with Washington.

pro.zh: 议会过半需61席。艾森科特阵营48席加阿拉伯政党19席可达67席，但前提是打破选前承诺。赫尔佐格那句“并非所有承诺都能兑现”，正是在给这类安排或跨阵营交易留余地。总统有很大裁量权，不必选第一大党领袖。
pro.en: A Knesset majority needs 61. Eisenkot's 48 plus the Arab parties' 19 makes 67, but only if pre-election pledges are broken. Herzog's line that not every promise can be kept reads as cover for that kind of arrangement or a cross-bloc deal. The president has wide discretion and need not pick the leader of the largest party.

label.zh: 阿拉伯政党联盟所获议席，创纪录
label.en: Seats won by Arab-led alliances, a record

explain.zh: 自己当不了主角，却能决定谁当主角的一方，好比投票僵持时手握关键一票的人。
explain.en: A party that can't win power itself but decides who does, like the swing vote in a deadlocked room.

explain.zh: 以色列国内安全机构，大致相当于负责反恐和反间谍的国内情报部门。
explain.en: Israel's domestic security service, roughly its internal counter-terrorism and counter-espionage agency.
